page.overview:
Who is The Elephant?

The Elephant is a supervillain who wears an Elephant costume, possessing the same strength of said animal. He is a minor antagonist in Invincible.

The Elephant wears a full-body suit that resembles an elephant. The suit is bulky and gray, mimicking the thick hide of an elephant. He has a large, stylized elephant head as a mask, complete with a trunk and tusks. His size makes him an ideal training dummy for younger heroes like Oliver. Mostly gray with possibly some metallic or armor-like textures, matching the "elephant skin" theme.

The Elephant knows he is not a top tier villain. He is a low level tough, more brawn than brains, a common brute and thug who relies on force and presence rather than schemes. He is not cruel for cruelty sake, and he is not out to inflict needless suffering. In many ways, he is a muscle for hire, though he can be quick to anger and violence.

The Elephant is a strict plant-eater and genuinely wants people to stop eating meat, but often resorts to aggressive means to achieve this despite the fact that it never works.
